results.remarks: Set on an exceptionally rare **flat ¾-acre lot**, this beautifully remodeled home offers the space, flexibility, and possibilities that are increasingly difficult to find. With 5 bedrooms, 3 baths and 2,297 square feet, the home was professionally remodeled in 2023 and features a versatile floor plan ideally suited for **multigenerational living, extended family, guests, or work-from-home needs**. Two separate primary en-suites provide exceptional flexibility, including one conveniently located on the main level and a second tucked into its own private space upstairs. And when it's time to trade convenience for the coast, Oceanside's beaches, harbor, pier and vibrant downtown are just a short drive away.

results.remarks: Welcome to 844 Rio Claro Ct, a beautifully updated home where timeless comfort meets everyday functionality. Nestled on a quiet cul-de-sac with only nine homes, this exceptional 4-bedroom, 3-bath residence offers privacy, space, and an abundance of natural light that fills the home with warmth and invites you in.  Designed for today’s lifestyle, the thoughtfully designed floor plan includes a highly sought-after entry-level bedroom and full bathroom—ideal for guests, multigenerational living, or a private home office. Pride of ownership is evident throughout with extensive upgrades, including a complete PEX repipe, tankless water heater, newer interior and exterior paint, newer luxury vinyl plank flooring downstairs, newer carpet upstairs, and a beautifully quartz countertop in kitchen. Step outside to the expansive pool-sized backyard, offering endless opportunities to create your own outdoor oasis, with additional potential for RV parking. The desirable location allows for an easy walk to nearby schools while enjoying the peace and charm of a small cul-de-sac community.  Best of all, there are no HOA fees and no Mello-Roos, making this home as practical as it is beautiful. Combining thoughtful updates, abundant natural light, generous outdoor space totaling approximateley .26 acres , and an unbeatable location, 844 Rio Claro Ct is a place you’ll be proud to call home.

results.remarks: Welcome to 4136 Sitio Flor, a newer Oceanside home offering an exceptional combination of location, condition, community amenities, and low HOA fees. results.remarks: Every gated community has a handful of homes that people quietly hope will come up. In St. Cloud, it's the end units the ones with a private entrance of their own, only a single shared wall, and windows on three sides. This is one of them, and it is every bit as bright as you're imagining. Built in 2019, this three-level townhome offers approximately 1,702 square feet, 3 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms. High ceilings and designer finishes set the tone the moment you step inside, and custom plantation shutters on every window let you decide exactly how much of that Southern California sun to invite in full and golden in the morning, filtered and soft in the afternoon. The main level is one connected, open space: a kitchen finished with quartz countertops, a full backsplash, stainless steel appliances, crisp cabinetry and an island with seating, opening directly to the dining and living areas. Weeknight dinners are easy here. So is a house full of people. Warm wood laminate flooring runs throughout the level, with a powder room tucked away for guests. The main-level bedroom with its own en-suite bath is the detail buyers remember. Visiting family, a live in parent, a roommate, or a genuinely private home office it solves a problem most townhomes don't. Upstairs, the primary suite is a retreat: walk-in closet, dual vanities, room to exhale. A secondary bedroom, full bath and upper-level laundry complete the floor, with plush carpet underfoot throughout the bedroom level. Downstairs, the oversized two-car attached garage has been finished with durable epoxy flooring and opens directly into the home. St. Cloud is one of the strongest amenity packages in Rancho Del Oro, and it shows: a junior Olympic swimming pool and spa with a newly resurfaced deck, shaded cabanas, a clubhouse with kitchenette you can reserve for private gatherings, a fitness center, BBQ and picnic areas, a basketball court, playgrounds, and wide green lawns for the kind of afternoon that doesn't need a plan. Grounds are professionally maintained, guest parking is plentiful, and the whole community sits behind controlled-access gates. Martin Luther King Jr. Park is right across the way skate park, baseball and soccer fields, and a tot lot. Ivey Ranch Elementary and Martin Luther King Jr. Middle School are an easy walk, with El Camino High nearby. Ocean Ranch and Frontier shopping, grocery, restaurants, gyms, coffee and golf are all minutes out, public transportation is close, and Highways 76 and 78 plus I-5 put Carlsbad, Vista, San Marcos and Camp Pendleton within a short drive. Point the car west and you're at Oceanside Harbor, the pier, the Thursday farmers market and open beach in about ten minutes. First-time buyers who refuse to compromise on location. Investors who understand what gated, amenity-rich and walkable does for demand. And anyone downsizing who wants less maintenance without giving up a single square foot of lifestyle. FHA and VA approved, turnkey, and ready right now. Stylish, secure, and perfectly located, this is the Southern California coastal lifestyle without the coastal-maintenance headache. Schedule your private showing today, because the end units in St. Cloud hardly come around.
